svg.text: The archive books each mission at its first waypoint
Zone D and Đồng Xoài, 2,181 spray runs. Both maps below use the same 3 km cells and the same dot-area scale — only the accounting differs.

g.text: Each line is one spray run; width is gallons per kilometre.
526 cells carry volume. Peak cell 95K gallons.
Rings mark the 496 cells that were dosed and this map leaves empty.
1,018 cells carry volume. Peak cell 31K gallons.

In this window 37% of the volume fell in cells the booked reading shows as empty, and its hottest cell is 3.1× hotter than any ground actually was. Across the whole record those figures are 43% and 2.5×.
Source: HERBS tape (Stellman et al., 2003). Runs with a recorded volume only; a run logged at a single grid reference is identical under both readings.
